nber-agenda.name: nber-agenda
nber-agenda.description: Fetch the agenda of any NBER conference or program meeting (Summer Institute, program meetings, working groups, methods conferences) as clean text or structured JSON — titles, authors, affiliations, discussants, and uploaded paper/slide links. NBER agenda pages render client-side, so a plain fetch returns only a 'Loading...' placeholder; this skill resolves the hidden agenda endpoint for you. Use it to survey the research frontier — what top groups are presenting right now, often months before the work is published or has a DOI.
